**EDIT:**

I was able to reproduce this issue. Initially, I didn't fully understand the issue description; here are two videos for comparison.

<details><summary>Video dev3 vs. dev4</summary>

### dev3

https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/b7bab651-bf23-439f-8337-75e786f062b9


### dev4

https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/f7d4b35a-041d-44fb-adc8-a3b35126aaad


</details>

------------------

- Not reproducible on Android.
- This is also reproducible on macOS when I switch from `Metal` to `Vulkan`. 

```
Godot Engine v4.6.beta2.official.551ce8d47 - https://godotengine.org
Vulkan 1.2.283 - Forward+ - Using Device #0: Apple - Apple M1
```
_I am using MacOS 15.7.x, not yet updated to MacOS 26._

-------------

- Also reproducible with `Compatibility` renderer

```
Godot Engine v4.6.beta2.official.551ce8d47 - https://godotengine.org
OpenGL API 4.1 Metal - 89.4 - Compatibility - Using Device: Apple - Apple M1
```

I can't reproduce this on either 4.5.1.stable or 4.6.rc https://github.com/godotengine/godot/commit/481f36ed20520db3195a09cc309abf48c03cf51a (using a release export template). The MRP looks identical with both versions on Metal. I've tried `--max-fps 60` as well in case this was a FPS-dependent issue, but I didn't manage to reproduce it with a FPS cap either.

<details open>
<summary>Mac specifications</summary>

- MacBook Pro 16 2024
- **SoC:** M4 Max 16-core CPU, 40-core GPU
- **RAM:** 48 GB
- **SSD:** 1 TB
- **OS:** macOS 26.1
</details>
